_comment: MCP server template shipped by midas. Secrets are NEVER bundled - every credential
is a dollar-brace environment placeholder resolved from the midas credentials file or
the environment at install time. `midas touch --mcp` writes the resolved copy to
~/.config/midas/mcp.json with mode 0600 and leaves unresolved placeholders in place
so a missing credential fails loudly instead of silently disabling a server.
